name: ECON 2202
title: Intermediate Macroeconomic Theory
description: Intermediate macroeconomic theory, covering  national income accounting; the determination of aggregate output, employment and price levels; elements of business cycles and economic growth.
requirement_description: ECON 1200 or 1202; one of MATH 1071Q, 1110Q, 1121Q, 1131Q, 1151Q, or 2141Q. Recommended preparation: ECON 1201. Not open for credit to students who have passed ECON 2212Q.
